summary: Incremental corrections also count an evaluation that found an earlier due time than a skipping pass would have woken for, and st performance lists corrections by item and cause (write or due)

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: What the reconciler does is unchanged; only what it counts. The INCREMENTAL CORRECTIONS rows in st performance now read `item · write` or `item · due` instead of `item`, and a missed due time is counted where before it went unseen. Tests built with strict incremental checking fail on either cause.

recovery.detail: An older build counts only missed writes, by item.
